ns2:course.label: History of American Families
ns2:course.description: Overview of family life in the United States from colonial times to the present. History of childhood and adolescence, dating and courtship, sex and reproduction, husband-wife relations, female-headed households, and aging. Major transformations in family structure and authority patterns, and consequences of those transformations. Same as HDFS 421. 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: One year of college history.
